recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future jurisdiction expansion issue recurs, handle it through THO/UTG or terminology tooling rather than reintroducing a core ValueSet or manually editing generated SVG links.
issue_request: FHIR-14695 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocab issue reporting that the 2018-Jan jurisdiction ValueSet expansion link showed an unable-to-expand tooling error for urn:iso:std:iso:3166; the final resolution says May 2018 ballot QA made the expansion render properly.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-14695 or 14695 was found, so the issue appears to have been applied through ballot QA or terminology tooling rather than a Jira-tagged source commit. Historical source did define source/terminologies/valueset-jurisdiction.xml, and the R5 published core page rendered an expansion instead of the original error.
additional_context: FHIR-18280 and FHIR-20375 later reported the same jurisdiction expansion/tooling failure and were resolved as fixed or known tooling work, while FHIR-31537 was later Resolved - No Change because the value set expanded in the current build. UP-521 and TI minutes moved the deprecated core Jurisdiction ValueSet to THO. Current core source no longer has source/terminologies/valueset-jurisdiction.xml, active non-SVG source references use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction, and only generated-looking SVG diagrams still contain valueset-jurisdiction.html links.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current authoritative core source does not reference the old broken core page and the active THO Jurisdiction ValueSet renders expansion content for the same CLD.
